periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees relative to the muzzle-forehead axis
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a width-to-height ratio approximately 1.6:1
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward taper with the lower edge extending toward the lateral muzzle

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape along the posterior boundary where dark fur meets the discolored ventral pelage
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, covering the entire scapular and upper-humeral regions

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide spacing, approximately equal to the breadth of the cranial dome between the ears
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular profile at the top edge

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown-earth tone staining across the typically white abdominal and lateral fur regions
